@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	auth "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+var authMethods = map[string]auth.Method{
+	"token":      auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN,
+	"oidc":       auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC,
+	"kubernetes": auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"k8s":        auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES,
+	"github":     auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB,
+	"jwt":        auth.Method_METHOD_JWT,
+	"cloud":      auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD,
+}
+
+func init() {
+	rego.RegisterBuiltin2(&rego.Function{
+		Name: "flipt.is_auth_method",
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(
+			types.Args(types.NewObject(nil, types.NewDynamicProperty(types.S, types.A)), types.S),
+			types.B,
+		),
+	}, isAuthMethod)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	authentication := input.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	name := string(key.Value.(ast.String))
+	method, ok := authMethods[name]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", name)
+	}
+
+	actual := authentication.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(actual != nil && actual.Equal(ast.IntNumberTerm(int(method)))), nil
+}
diff --git a/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go b/internal/server/authz/engine/ext/extentions_test.go

@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	auth "go.flipt.io/flipt/rpc/flipt/auth"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		method auth.Method
+	}{
+		{"token", auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN},
+		{"oidc", auth.Method_METHOD_OIDC},
+		{"kubernetes", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"k8s", auth.Method_METHOD_KUBERNETES},
+		{"github", auth.Method_METHOD_GITHUB},
+		{"jwt", auth.Method_METHOD_JWT},
+		{"cloud", auth.Method_METHOD_CLOUD},
+	} {
+		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			input := ast.ObjectTerm(
+				ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"), ast.ObjectTerm(
+					ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(int(tc.method))),
+				)),
+			)
+			result, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tc.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(true), result)
+
+			other := auth.Method_METHOD_TOKEN
+			if tc.method == other {
+				other = auth.Method_METHOD_JWT
+			}
+			input = ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"), ast.ObjectTerm(
+				ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("method"), ast.IntNumberTerm(int(other))),
+			)))
+			result, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, input, ast.StringTerm(tc.name))
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, ast.BooleanTerm(false), result)
+		})
+	}
+
+	_, err := isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(), ast.StringTerm("token"))
+	require.EqualError(t, err, "no authentication found")
+
+	_, err = isAuthMethod(rego.BuiltinContext{}, ast.ObjectTerm(ast.Item(ast.StringTerm("authentication"), ast.ObjectTerm())), ast.StringTerm("unknown"))
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported auth method") && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unknown"))
+}
